From: Bethany Ramos <bethany@lumina.ai>

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: POC runway extension request – usage surge

Hi Marissa,

Quick note from our side — the engineering team pushed a larger workload into the POC yesterday and we blew past the originally forecasted token burn. We have a customer demo scheduled for Dec 2 and need another 10–14 days of runway to finish integration testing.

Can we get a 2-week extension on the current POC window? If a full no-cost extension isn’t possible, what pricing or credit options would you recommend to keep things moving? We’d prefer a simple path — either a short extension or a token credit we can use immediately.

I attached a brief usage extract for transparency (poc-usage-summary-nov19.csv). CC’ing salesops for procurement visibility.

Thanks,
Bethany Ramos
VP Product, Lumina AI
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Bethany Ramos <bethany@lumina.ai>
Cc: salesops@lumina.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC runway extension request – usage surge

Bethany — thanks for the note and for sharing the usage file. We saw the same spike in our console (nice to see the integration ramp). Two immediate options that are standard for this type of short-run overshoot:

1) Two-week runway extension at no charge, provided we execute a short addendum (signs off the extension and confirms current demo date). This keeps the POC active without billing and lets us maintain the existing SLOs.

2) If you need more runway after that, a token credit package (25k tokens) at a 20% discounted rate that applies immediately and can be used during the POC.

Operational note: if you choose option 1 we’ll need the addendum signed this week so we can schedule capacity. I’ve attached a draft addendum (extension-addendum-draft.pdf) for quick review. I can also loop in Finance/Legal if you want standard procurement language.

Would you prefer the no-cost bridge or the credit? If you want, we can do a quick 15-min sync this afternoon to finalize.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Priyom / David — forwarding Lumina’s request (they hit a burst). Short summary: customer asks for a 10–14 day extension to complete integration and demo. Usage spike is in the attached CSV.

Options I’m proposing to them:
- Option A: 14-day no-charge extension if Lumina signs our short addendum this week. No finance upsell required.
- Option B: 25k token credit at 20% discount, applied immediately, which buys them runway and aligns with standard add-on billing.

Decision factors:
- Impact to capacity (we can absorb a 2-week extension in their region without risking other reserved pools)
- Precedent (we’ve done one no-cost short bridge for a similar mid-market account this quarter)
- Financial tradeoff vs. potential expansion (they’re a likely mid-size expansion/opportunity — deal ID DEAL-8421).

My recommended route: approve Option A to remove friction for the demo. If Finance is uncomfortable, we offer Option B with a short discount but include a conversion clause (credit applies to any committed purchase in 90 days).

If you approve Option A I’ll send the addendum and schedule capacity.

Thanks — Marissa
